RequirementText: Login with email and password; valid login returns JWT; failed attempts lock account
Notes: Stateful cases require isolated disposable account or database reseed. LOGIN-025/026/027 are VALID spec oracles but expose implementation bugs (+2 counter, lock after 2, 180s lock) - see audit entry 03. SLOGIN-001 adds the lock-expiry recovery transition.

All labeled VALID except LOGIN-015 (INCOMPLETE, corrected: concrete 300-char email + no-500 oracle). Missing-password/null-password cases increment the failure counter as a side effect - use a disposable account.

RequirementText: Injection and hostile input resistance / password must not be plaintext
Notes: Injection cases VALID (parameterized query, no bypass). SLOGIN-003 adds a hard field-absence assertion. BUG: SEC-01 violated - password stored and returned in plaintext (verified).

RequirementText: Sensitive response data must not be disclosed
Notes: LOGIN-039 VALID oracle but exposes a bug: response user object includes password/reset_token/login_attempts/locked_until. SLOGIN-003 pins exact forbidden fields.
Verified parameterized query in /api/login; SQL injection returns 401 with no bypass. SQLi password case (LOGIN-022) also VALID.
JWT decodes to id/role claims. Schema check must assert the forbidden sensitive fields are absent (see SLOGIN-003).
SLOGIN-004 (student-added) differentially checks locked vs unknown responses. BUG: locked -> 403 + distinct message vs unknown -> 401 -> enumeration weakness (verified).

RequirementText: Protocol/body robustness (content type, malformed JSON, wrong-shape bodies, method set)
Notes: LOGIN-034 corrected (must be no-500). BUG: text/plain -> 500 stack trace; malformed JSON / string body -> 400 HTML error page leaking file paths (verified). SLOGIN-005 extends method set; SLOGIN-006 adds wrong-shape bodies.
